title: Architecture: ResNet18d (deep stem), recipe R, 300 epochs
hypothesis: The deep-stem variant of ResNet18 should help small-detail plant classification.
findings: ResNet18d beats ResNet18 (EXP-008, 0.672) by +0.08 and the bigger ResNets by +0.06.
limitations: Architecture and TTA both differ from EXP-008; the gain is not isolated to the stem.
